sourceReferences: design-review-locked/Mentora Showcase.dc.html § 22 Product Preview — WEB PREVIEW

layout.structure: two-column hero (headline column + course-artwork collage column) at desktop+, single column stacked below desktop

heroCollage.description: one large course-thumbnail card + a row of smaller course-thumbnail cards below it, per the showcase's asymmetric composition — NOT a uniform equal-size grid.
heroCollage.currentImplementation: 3-equal-column grid with the first item spanning the full row (an approximation of the showcase's mixed-size composition, corrected in D49 from an earlier 2-column layout — see execution/DECISIONS_LOG.md D49). Remaining gap: not byte-identical to the showcase's own mixed large+medium+wide proportions.
heroCollage.source: inferred proportions — the showcase's exact per-card width ratios were not individually re-measured pixel-for-pixel; grid-template-columns evidence extracted (repeat(3,1fr) family patterns present in showcase CSS) corroborates a 3-up small-card row is plausible.

content: headline h1 (contentRole: heroTitle) — multi-line, typography.display.large at desktop
trust markers row (course count, learning-path count, language count)
3 short value-prop blocks — icon + heading.h4 + body.small each, composed from existing tokens, no new component

artworkRules: shared/artwork.json — hero collage and Popular Courses row both use the governed course-artwork system, never a generic photo or flat placeholder.
ltrBehavior: default reading order, hero text/CTAs start-aligned
rtlBehavior: hero text/buttons mirror per logical properties; CTA button order (primary first) stays consistent, not physically fixed
themeBehavior: standard semantic token resolution, light/dark; no screen-specific hardcoded colors
responsiveRules: hero stacks to single column on Mobile, CTA buttons stack full-width; featured rows drop to courseGrid column count per breakpoint
knownGaps: Hero collage proportions are an approximation of the showcase's mixed large+small composition, not a byte-identical layout (see layout.heroCollage.currentImplementation).
